n7936bbb7b4.headline: UK will not get everything they want in deal - Coveney
n7936bbb7b4.summary: Ireland's Tánaiste Simon Coveney stated that the EU will not fully accept the UK's Brexit proposals due to concerns over selective single market access.
n7936bbb7b4.why: Brexit negotiations impact trade, regulatory alignment, and economic relations between the UK, EU, and global markets.
n7936bbb7b4.why_moved: Statements on Brexit negotiations influence market expectations about trade barriers and economic relations, affecting currency and equity markets.
